title: Context Meter
description: See the current context window fill and remaining tokens.
use: Check headroom before a large refactor.
access: Reads session usage. No files, processes, network, or persistence.

title: Quota Watch
description: Inspect reported plan windows and their reset times.
use: Plan work around the limits your session reports.
access: Reads session usage only.

title: Cache Inspector
description: Track API cache reads, writes, and uncached input by request.
use: Check whether repeated turns are using the prompt cache.
access: Observes request token counts and model names in memory. No model calls.

title: Tool Timing
description: Measure observed tool latency, call counts, and failures.
use: Find tools that slow down a session.
access: Observes tool names, results, and clock; does not store arguments.

title: Error Inbox
description: Keep the last 30 failed or refused tool calls in one pane.
use: Revisit failures without searching the transcript.
access: Keeps truncated tool error text in memory; may contain sensitive output.

title: Edit Heatmap
description: Count successful Edit and Write calls by path.
use: See which files receive the most attention.
access: Observes edited file paths; no content reads or persistence.

title: Turn Timeline
description: Show duration, token totals, and interruption state per turn.
use: Compare long and short turns.
access: Observes turn durations and counts only; no answer storage.

title: Agent Board
description: Inspect the subagents reported by the session.
use: Keep track of delegated work without messaging anyone.
access: Reads agent metadata only. Does not spawn or message agents.

title: Branch Board
description: Inspect local branches, upstreams, and dirty files.
use: Choose a branch with current work in view.
access: Runs read-only Git commands only when opened or refreshed. Git must be on PATH. No network, writes, or persistence.

title: Staged Review
description: Review the staged diff before committing.
use: Check exactly what would go into your next commit.
access: Runs read-only Git commands only when opened or refreshed. Git must be on PATH. No network, writes, or persistence.

title: Commit Browser
description: Browse the latest 20 commits with author and subject.
use: Find a recent change without leaving Claude Code.
access: Runs read-only Git commands only when opened or refreshed. Git must be on PATH. No network, writes, or persistence.

title: Stash Browser
description: List stashes and inspect a selected stash diff.
use: Recover the context of parked work without applying it.
access: Runs read-only Git commands only when opened or refreshed. Git must be on PATH. No network, writes, or persistence.

title: Worktree Map
description: List worktree paths, branches, and locked states.
use: See where parallel work lives.
access: Runs read-only Git commands only when opened or refreshed. Git must be on PATH. No network, writes, or persistence.

title: Conflict Radar
description: List unresolved paths and count conflict markers in tracked files.
use: Find remaining merge conflicts.
access: Runs read-only Git commands only when opened or refreshed. Git must be on PATH. No network, writes, or persistence.

title: Blame View
description: Read authorship for the first 80 lines of a chosen tracked file.
use: Understand who last changed a line.
access: Runs read-only Git commands only when opened or refreshed. Git must be on PATH. No network, writes, or persistence.

title: Ignore Check
description: Explain which Git ignore rule matches a path.
use: Debug an unexpectedly ignored file.
access: Runs read-only Git commands only when opened or refreshed. Git must be on PATH. No network, writes, or persistence.

title: File Tree
description: Browse one directory at a time with clickable folders.
use: Explore a project without flooding the transcript.
access: Lists the directory the user chooses. Does not recursively walk or read file content.

title: Package Scripts
description: List npm scripts and package identity without running them.
use: Find available project commands.
access: Reads the chosen file (up to 256 KiB) on request. No writes, processes, network, or persistence.

title: Dependency Table
description: Inspect dependency groups from a package manifest.
use: Check declared versions before upgrading.
access: Reads the chosen file (up to 256 KiB) on request. No writes, processes, network, or persistence.

title: TODO Finder
description: Find TODO, FIXME, and HACK notes in tracked files.
use: Build a quick backlog from the code already in your repo.
access: Runs read-only git grep on request. Tracked files only; requires Git.

title: Markdown Map
description: Build a heading outline with source line numbers.
use: Navigate a long README or design document.
access: Reads the chosen file (up to 256 KiB) on request. No writes, processes, network, or persistence.

title: JSON Browser
description: Summarize top-level JSON keys with types and a formatted preview.
use: Inspect a local API response or configuration.
access: Reads the chosen file (up to 256 KiB) on request. No writes, processes, network, or persistence.

title: CSV Table
description: Preview quoted CSV fields, row counts, and column headers.
use: Read an exported dataset without launching a spreadsheet.
access: Reads the chosen file (up to 256 KiB) on request. No writes, processes, network, or persistence.

title: Log Viewer
description: Show the last 60 lines of a small local log with an optional filter.
use: Inspect a development log on demand.
access: Reads the chosen file (up to 256 KiB) on request. No writes, processes, network, or persistence.

title: Env Example
description: List variable names and missing placeholders in an example env file.
use: Review setup requirements without reading your real .env.
access: Reads only paths named env example, sample, or template (up to 256 KiB). Displays variable names and placeholder presence; no values.

title: File Compare
description: Compare two small text files by line without editing either.
use: Check config or fixture differences.
access: Reads two explicitly chosen text files up to 64 KiB each. Positional comparison, not an edit-distance diff.

title: Scratchpad
description: Save short notes beside your conversation.
use: Keep temporary findings out of your prompt.
access: Stores user-entered items in this plugin’s local store, partitioned by workspace path. Each item has a separate key. No file writes or network.

title: Task Board
description: Add tasks and toggle done status.
use: Track the small jobs that appear during a session.
access: Stores user-entered items in this plugin’s local store, partitioned by workspace path. Each item has a separate key. No file writes or network.

title: Decision Log
description: Record dated engineering decisions.
use: Remember why you chose an approach.
access: Stores user-entered items in this plugin’s local store, partitioned by workspace path. Each item has a separate key. No file writes or network.

title: Snippet Shelf
description: Save and copy short code or command snippets.
use: Keep useful one-liners at hand.
access: Stores user-entered items in this plugin’s local store, partitioned by workspace path. Each item has a separate key. No file writes or network. Uses the clipboard.

title: Link Shelf
description: Save labeled HTTP and HTTPS reference links.
use: Keep docs for the current project visible.
access: Stores user-entered items in this plugin’s local store, partitioned by workspace path. Each item has a separate key. No file writes or network.

title: Prompt Shelf
description: Save reusable prompts and put one into the composer as a draft.
use: Reuse a review or debugging prompt without auto-submitting it.
access: Stores user-entered items in this plugin’s local store, partitioned by workspace path. Each item has a separate key. No file writes or network. Fills a draft in the composer on button press; does not submit a prompt.
sample: Review this patch for accessibility and edge cases

title: Release Checklist
description: Keep a persistent checklist for a release.
use: Track review, checks, and release tasks in one place.
access: Stores user-entered items in this plugin’s local store, partitioned by workspace path. Each item has a separate key. No file writes or network.
sample: Confirm build passes on a clean checkout

title: Handoff Notes
description: Keep a dated list of progress and next steps, then copy it.
use: Leave a useful handoff for the next session.
access: Stores user-entered items in this plugin’s local store, partitioned by workspace path. Each item has a separate key. No file writes or network. Uses the clipboard.
sample: Done: API parser. Next: verify empty responses.

title: Regex Lab
description: Test a regular expression against text and see matched ranges.
use: Debug a pattern before putting it in code.
access: Works on the text you enter, in memory. Uses the clipboard on request. No files, processes, network, persistence, or model calls.

title: JSON Format
description: Validate and pretty-print JSON without touching a file.
use: Clean up a copied API response.
access: Works on the text you enter, in memory. Uses the clipboard on request. No files, processes, network, persistence, or model calls.

title: URL Lab
description: Inspect URL components and decoded query parameters locally.
use: Debug a callback URL without visiting it.
access: Works on the text you enter, in memory. Uses the clipboard on request. No files, processes, network, persistence, or model calls.

title: Base64 Lab
description: Encode UTF-8 text or decode strict Base64.
use: Inspect a payload without sending it anywhere.
access: Works on the text you enter, in memory. Uses the clipboard on request. No files, processes, network, persistence, or model calls.

title: Time Lab
description: Convert Unix seconds, milliseconds, or an ISO date to UTC.
use: Compare timestamps from logs and APIs.
access: Works on the text you enter, in memory. Uses the clipboard on request. No files, processes, network, persistence, or model calls.

title: Hash Lab
description: Calculate SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512 for UTF-8 text.
use: Compare a checksum for a short string.
access: Works on the text you enter, in memory. Uses the clipboard on request. No files, processes, network, persistence, or model calls.

title: Color Lab
description: Convert hex colors and measure contrast against a background.
use: Check a foreground and background pair while designing.
access: Works on the text you enter, in memory. Uses the clipboard on request. No files, processes, network, persistence, or model calls.

title: UUID Lab
description: Generate up to 20 random UUID v4 values locally.
use: Make IDs for fixtures and examples.
access: Works on the text you enter, in memory. Uses the clipboard on request. No files, processes, network, persistence, or model calls.

title: Text Counter
description: Count words, lines, Unicode code points, and UTF-8 bytes.
use: Check text lengths before publishing or sending a payload.
access: Works on the text you enter, in memory. Uses the clipboard on request. No files, processes, network, persistence, or model calls.

title: ASCII Flipbook
description: Play a local text animation whose frames are separated by a form feed.
use: Preview ASCII storyboards in a pane without a video decoder.
access: Reads a chosen text animation (up to 128 KiB), uses a 2 fps timer. No ffmpeg, audio, video decoding, or network.

title: Focus Clock
description: Run a 25-minute focus countdown with pause, reset, and a toast.
use: Keep a work interval visible during a long task.
access: Uses a local clock and a completion toast. No files, network, or persistence.

title: Stopwatch
description: Time a task with start, pause, and lap markers.
use: Measure a manual debugging or review session.
access: Uses a local clock; laps live in memory.

title: Test Ledger
description: Record likely test, lint, and build commands and their tool status.
use: Keep validation attempts in view, with honest evidence boundaries.
access: Observes Bash command strings and tool status in memory. Does not execute commands.

title: Command History
description: Keep the last 40 Bash command strings and copy one for reuse.
use: Find a command Claude ran earlier in this session.
access: Observes Bash command arguments in memory; may include secrets. Clipboard only on request. No persistence.

title: Scope Watch
description: Warn when observed file edits leave a chosen path prefix.
use: Notice scope creep during a focused change.
access: Observes Edit/Write paths, reads session cwd, and toasts on out-of-prefix edits. Does not block calls.

title: Read-only Mode
description: Toggle a reminder guard that refuses built-in mutating tools and Bash.
use: Use a session for inspection with an extra visible guard.
access: Refuses selected tool.call events when manually enabled. No permission approvals. Not a security boundary; other tools/mods can write.

title: Desktop Usage Strip
description: Show quota, reset countdowns, tokens, and cost in a composer strip.
use: Keep the reference image’s usage information beside your prompt.
access: Reads reported session usage; missing figures remain labeled not reported. No pricing guesses or subscription billing calculation. Observes the latest 30 API requests in memory. Draws a composable AbovePrompt band on Desktop where the host exposes it; the command pane always offers the full display. Refreshes countdowns every minute.

title: Desktop Context Map
description: Chart context headroom and sampled window growth.
use: Spot a filling context window visually.
access: Reads reported session usage; missing figures remain labeled not reported. No pricing guesses or subscription billing calculation. Samples after observed completed turns; latest 12 samples, reset on reload.

title: Desktop Quota Clock
description: Chart reported plan windows with live reset countdowns.
use: See when each quota window is due to reset.
access: Reads reported session usage; missing figures remain labeled not reported. No pricing guesses or subscription billing calculation. Clock redraws once per minute; reaching zero does not invent a new quota reading.

title: Desktop Cost Watch
description: Set a local budget reminder against reported session USD.
use: Keep a session cost target visible without changing tool permissions.
access: Reads reported session usage; missing figures remain labeled not reported. No pricing guesses or subscription billing calculation. Saves a user-entered budget per workspace in the local plugin store. Does not enforce a spending limit.

title: Desktop Token Flow
description: Chart uncached input, output, cache reads, and cache writes.
use: Compare token sources across observed requests.
access: Observes API usage from the latest 30 completed requests in memory; includes any agent requests routed through the session. No model calls.

title: Desktop Tool Pulse
description: Chart completed tool latency and failures by tool.
use: See which observed tools take time or fail.
access: Observes tool names, completion/refusal/error state and local clock durations for the latest 100 calls. Does not save command arguments or tool results.

title: Desktop Turn Chart
description: Chart turn durations with interruption labels.
use: Compare the duration of your latest turns.
access: Observes durations, agent IDs and interruption flags for the latest 12 completed turns; memory only.

title: Desktop Edit Map
description: Chart successful built-in edits grouped by file path.
use: See which files Claude has touched this session.
access: Observes successful Edit/Write file paths only, latest 100 calls in memory. Does not read file contents; not a full filesystem audit.

title: Desktop Agent Desk
description: Filter reported agents and copy a status snapshot.
use: Keep a readable agent roster next to the conversation.
access: Reads engine-reported agent metadata on refresh. No spawning, messages, transcript reads, or agent control. Clipboard on button press.

title: Desktop Review Desk
description: Switch between Git status, staged diff, and unstaged diff.
use: Inspect a change from one desktop review pane.
access: Runs read-only Git argv commands in session cwd only when opened or refreshed. External diff and textconv disabled. Output truncated to 9,000 characters. Clipboard only on press.

title: Desktop File Desk
description: Read a bounded text file with line filtering and path drafting.
use: Inspect a file while preparing a precise question about it.
access: Reads a user-chosen regular text file up to 128 KiB on input submission; no automatic reads. Symlinks/binary files refused, preview truncated to 9,000 characters and 100 matching lines. Paths may point to private files. Fills a composer draft on press; never submits it.

title: Desktop Markdown Reader
description: Render a local Markdown document with a source tab.
use: Read project documentation in a desktop pane.
access: Reads a chosen .md file up to 128 KiB, refuses symlinks, renders at most 9,000 characters. Markdown links behave like normal links when clicked; mod makes no network requests. Clipboard on press.

title: Desktop Compare Desk
description: Compare two local text files in responsive side-by-side columns.
use: Check two versions without switching windows.
access: Reads two user-chosen regular non-symlink text files up to 128 KiB each on Compare. No writes. Line positions compare truncated previews; insertions shift subsequent positions.

title: Desktop Prompt Builder
description: Build a saved prompt from goal, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
use: Prepare a clear request before filling the composer.
access: Saves up to 2,000 characters per field in a workspace-partitioned local store. Copy/fill only on press. Fill replaces the composer draft without submitting a prompt.

title: Desktop Session Brief
description: Combine observed tool and turn counts with a manual handoff note.
use: Copy a factual session summary with your next step.
access: Observes tool status and turn completion counts in memory; reads cwd. Does not read messages or tool outputs. User note and counters reset on reload; clipboard on press.

title: Desktop Bookmark Dock
description: Keep labeled web references with copy and delete controls.
use: Put project references one click away.
access: Stores up to 100 user-entered HTTP/HTTPS bookmarks per workspace; credential URLs refused. Clipboard on press. Clicking a link uses the host browser. Mod makes no network requests.

title: Desktop Checklist Desk
description: Move saved work items through To do, Doing, and Done columns.
use: Track a small workflow on the desktop.
access: Stores up to 100 user-entered work items per workspace. Move/delete only on press; reload sees other sessions. Same-item concurrent changes are last-write-wins. Responsive columns stack in narrow panes.

title: Desktop Workspace Home
description: Show the current workspace, Git state, and session usage together.
use: Orient yourself when switching between desktop sessions.
access: Reads cwd and reported usage; runs read-only git status argv on open/reload, bounded to 9,000 characters. Clipboard on press. No filesystem writes.

title: Desktop Break Bell
description: Set an adjustable countdown with a visual progress chart and toast.
use: Remember a break during a long desktop session.
access: Uses a local one-second clock and one completion toast; memory only, reset on reload. Does not play audio or send an OS notification.

title: Desktop JSON Desk
description: Validate pasted JSON with a searchable key summary and formatted preview.
use: Inspect an API response visually without a file or network request.
access: Parses pasted JSON locally, input up to 9,000 characters, first 50 matching top-level keys, display capped at 9,000 characters. Clipboard on press (up to 30,000 characters). No files or persistence.
